questions.prompt: Why does a CI merge gate script effectively enforce code quality?

options.a: The job's exit code determines if the merge is allowed, preventing inattention from bypassing checks
options.b: It sends an email notification to repository maintainers
options.c: It automatically reformats code in production

questions.prompt: What is the difference between `shfmt -d` and `shfmt -w`?

options.a: `-d` displays a diff and exits nonzero on drift; `-w` rewrites the file in place
options.b: They are identical aliases for formatting code

questions.prompt: Why does `tools/shellcheck-all.sh` inspect untracked files in addition to tracked files?

options.a: A newly created script that was not yet staged would otherwise be skipped and produce a false clean result
options.b: Git strictly mandates checking untracked files
